title: 想加班多挣钱，英语怎么跟组长说？
summary: 美国工厂加班一般 1.5 倍工资。想加班要主动问，这篇教你怎么开口。

featuredPhrase.en: Can I work overtime this weekend?

phrases.en: Can I work overtime this weekend?
Let me know if you need extra help.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.en: Hi, is there any overtime this weekend?
dialogue.zh: 你好，这个周末有加班吗？

dialogue.speaker: Team Lead
dialogue.en: Yes, we need people on Saturday.

dialogue.speaker: Employee
dialogue.en: Can I work overtime on Saturday?

dialogue.speaker: Team Lead
dialogue.en: Sure. Be here at 7 in the morning.

seoDescription: 想在美国工厂加班多挣钱，怎么用英语问组长？本文教你开口要加班的实用说法和完整对话。
